mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 235 signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive Fed tightening that increases equity discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 850) and retail sales (RSAFS < 400000) signal broad economic weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 850 AND RSAFS < 400000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings visibility and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 850 thousand units signal weak residential demand, indicating broader economic slowdown and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 850 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) indicates stagflation, constraining Fed policy response and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2 AND CPIAUCSL > 230 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP level above 13700 billion dollars indicates robust economic expansion, supporting strong corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 13700 over any 3-year rolling window.
